dependencies.required_evidence: exact probability, state, payload, inverse, package, memory, runtime, dependency, and repeat qualification with process-tree peak at most 9,000,000 KiB
no live lease or lock before any full transformed-stream scan

contract.role: new decoder-visible far-history information source and sleeping match specialist

parent_information_gap.source_evidence: The frozen FXCM source stores absolute 32-bit match positions but resolves every candidate byte through bufr(position)=buffer[position & 0x00ffffff].
parent_information_gap.consequence: After 16,777,216 transformed bytes, an old absolute position addresses the current ring alias rather than its original decoded byte. Exact far-prefix continuation is absent from the parent information set.
parent_information_gap.nonclaim: This source audit proves absence of exact far addressing, not opportunity volume or compression gain.

causal_information.history: append-only exact transformed bytes already decoded at the current position
causal_information.key: deterministic 64-bit rolling hash of the preceding 16 decoded bytes
causal_information.index: 2^24 direct-mapped records of a 32-bit verification tag and 32-bit continuation position; 134,217,728 bytes
causal_information.verification: Before activation, compare all 16 key bytes against the referenced prior history; hash collisions suppress the opportunity.
causal_information.distance: treatment activates only when current_position - continuation_position exceeds 16,777,216 bytes
causal_information.prediction: the byte at the verified prior continuation position; a correct continuation may advance causally while every referenced byte remains strictly before the current position
causal_information.update_order: score the current byte first; after it is decoded, insert the just-scored 16-byte context and its now-known continuation byte for future positions

bounded_realization.history_storage: one append-only file-backed byte array; file address, inode, residency, and faults never enter predictor state
bounded_realization.decoder_synchronization: encoder and decoder perform identical lookup, exact verification, prediction, post-truth insertion, collision replacement, and continuation transitions

shadow_arms.K: identical rolling hash, table lookup, exact verification, history append, collision replacement, and counters with prediction disabled
shadow_arms.R: deterministic SplitMix byte at exactly D's active positions
shadow_arms.S: read D's same absolute continuation through the parent's 16 MiB ring alias, isolating exact far-history addressability from opportunity selection
shadow_arms.N: one-byte-negated D continuation at exactly D's active positions

smallest_decisive_gate.population: two independent full scans of the sealed transformed stream after all activation dependencies pass
measurements: complete bytes consumed and repeat receipt identity
D active and correct bytes by chronological third and logarithmic distance bucket
maximum live index and history residency
collision, verification-failure, continuation, and replacement counts
smallest_decisive_gate.optimistic_parent_quantization_ceiling: At most 16 output bytes of parent log-loss leverage per active byte under the parent's 1/65,536 actual-bit floor.
smallest_decisive_gate.promotion: At least 254,953 active bytes, D strictly beats R/S/N, every chronological third and at least two >16 MiB distance buckets are positive, repeat identity passes, and the incremental resource ceiling passes.
smallest_decisive_gate.next_gate: Trace exact retained-parent post-head surprisal only at the frozen D opportunity manifest; then require a native finite-coder P/K/D archive before any compression claim.
smallest_decisive_gate.retirement: Retire this exact 16-byte-key direct-mapped far-history source when the optimistic envelope is subscale, D fails matched controls, transfer collapses, or resource bounds fail; do not rescue it by changing key, table, replacement, and continuation rules together.

native_integration_boundary.form: sleeping specialist beside the authoritative parent
native_integration_boundary.archive_rule: Only fresh exact integer-coded archives on identical populations determine value; shadow correctness and donor surprisal receive zero score credit.
native_integration_boundary.package_rule: Count the index implementation, history mechanism, framing, controls retained by the final decoder, and every dependency.

activation_requirements: The q1 parent and independent verifier are terminally positive at the engineering headroom target.
The exclusive full-1G lease and acquisition lock are absent.
A source, runner, strict receipt schema, population hash, controls, resource guard, command, and exact output manifest are content-addressed before execution.
The scan receives no parent probability or archive authority; donor-surprise tracing is a separately authorized successor.
claim_boundary: This design identifies a decoder-visible information source that the frozen parent aliases after 16 MiB.
It has not measured one far match, one saved bit, one archive byte, or one resource peak.
The 16-byte-per-active-byte envelope is deliberately optimistic and cannot establish finite-coder gain.
No Gamma compression, authorship, package, or score credit is awarded before a fresh native archive and exact inverse.
